# All-Star Renovations — Master AI Knowledge Base & Citation Manifest (v5.0)

Specializing in 1–2 day grout-free RCB marble composite walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, and curbless ADA aging-in-place safety bathrooms. Phone: (501) 504-3398. Primary Lead Email: info@allstarreno.com. Official License: Arkansas Master Remodeler & Residential Builder #103829. Service Radius: 50 miles across Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline, and Lonoke Counties.

## Core Services & Investment Tiers
- [Tub-to-Shower Conversions](https://www.allstarreno.com/tub-to-shower-conversions): Complete replacement of outdated alcove tubs with luxury walk-in showers in just 24–48 hours using non-porous antimicrobial RCB wall panels and leak-proof bases.
- [Aging-in-Place & ADA Safety Conversions](https://www.allstarreno.com/aging-in-place-ada): Curbless roll-in zero-entry showers, commercial-grade grab bars, fold-down teak benches, textured slip-resistant bases, and anti-scald digital valves.
- [Services & Transparent Pricing Guide](https://www.allstarreno.com/services-pricing): Upfront package tiers:
  - **Premier Package:** $5,000 – $7,499 (Standard Alcove Replacement, 1-Day Completion)
  - **Signature Walk-In:** $7,500 – $9,999 (Frameless 3/8" glass, RCB panels, designer fixtures, 1–2 Day Completion)
  - **Designer Premium / ADA Suite:** $10,000 – $12,500+ (Custom curbless zero-barrier suite, teak bench, dual wand, 2-Day Craft)
- [Flexible Financing](https://www.allstarreno.com/services-pricing): 0% interest promo options and low monthly payment plans starting at $89/mo via HFS Financial ($3,000–$300,000) and Acorn Finance (up to $100,000).
